verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a natural-language interface inside Outlook itself is one community mention of Copilot integration in Outlook, from a user who still found it slower than copy-pasting. The Graph API docs are developer building blocks, and the LLM-via-MCP search report is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Copilot or natural-language commands in Outlook, the scope of actions those commands can perform (drafting, sending, searching, organizing), and hands-on corroboration that the commands work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: They sometimes miss the Copilot integration, but say copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook.
